name: SuperDashboard
desc:
SuperDashboard: a configurable dashboard reached from a floating bubble or the toolbar. Configurable sections: shortcuts (folders, notes, pdf, ...), a little file browser, name search (with a small query grammar), recent files, stars, keywords, a clock, device status (battery / free storage / stats), app launchers, and Note Clips. Several choices of designs and organisations, font (including MyStyle fonts) and text size.

Note Clips: lasso any part of a note and tap "Add to Dashboard" to pin it as a labelled thumbnail that links back to its exact source page: sort, filter by folder or label, size the thumbnails, and optionally mark the captured area on the note.

Clock: 12/24-hour, optional date, ISO or US week number, several faces (including a 7-segment "Digital" style), and extra time zones you dial in with +/- offsets from local time.

Fully offline (no internet). Needs file access: READ to scan notes for stars/keywords, browse/open files and capture clips; WRITE to save its own settings and, only when you turn it on, draw the clip frame on your note. Deleting a star or a clip is always an explicit tap.

Source & updates: https://github.com/AgP42/SuperDashboard; Support the plugin: https://ko-fi.com/agp42
